title: JavaScript Functions: Parameters, Return and Your First Function
description:
Write a reusable JavaScript function, pass in two numbers and return their sum. Learn how parameters, arguments and return work together.

Try answering: What should add(2, 3) return?

Parameters receive input, and return sends a result back to the caller.
Call the function with an argument to run its instructions.

Try it: Write a function that returns the sum of two numbers.
